en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard with two photographs of ancient marble busts on a cream background. The left image shows the bust of a curly‑haired male figure; the right image shows the bust of a woman. Greek and French captions identify them. Center‑top the card is labeled "ΑΘΗΝΑΙ – ATHÈNES." There is a circular postmark dated 6‑F‑1902 and a handwritten signature. At the bottom left there is a bilingual publication note in Greek and French, and at the bottom right the number 105 is printed.
